name: regionprops_pixellist
setup: BW = false(4,4); BW(2,2)=true; BW(2,3)=true; BW(3,3)=true; BW2 = false(5,5); BW2(1,1)=true; BW2(3,3)=true; BW2(3,4)=true; BW2(4,4)=true;
expr: s = regionprops(BW,'PixelIdxList','PixelList'); pil = s.PixelIdxList; n1 = numel(pil); idxrows = size(pil,1); i1 = pil(1); i2 = pil(2); i3 = pil(3); pl = s.PixelList; plr = size(pl,1); plc = size(pl,2); plx1 = pl(1,1); ply1 = pl(1,2); ply3 = pl(3,2); s2 = regionprops(BW2,'PixelIdxList'); r2a = s2(2).PixelIdxList(1); r2c = s2(2).PixelIdxList(3);
comment: regionprops PixelIdxList + PixelList fields vs MATLAB R2025b. DEEP-PROBE 2026-05-31 (toolbox pivot, toolboxes/image): both fields threw 'non-existent field'. Added: PixelIdxList = column vector of COLUMN-MAJOR 1-based linear indices of the region's pixels, sorted ascending; PixelList = P-by-2 [x y]=[col row] (1-based) in the same order. NOT part of the basic default set. 3-pixel region {(2,2),(2,3),(3,3)} in a 4x4: PixelIdxList=[6;10;11] (3x1), PixelList=[2 2;3 2;3 3]. Second region of BW2 {(3,3),(3,4),(4,4)} -> [13;18;19]. covers:[regionprops].
